overview: The Strip is the hub of the Gold Coast, inhabited by the bold and the beautiful, the rich and the desperate and all those simple battlers who have followed their own dreams of paradise. The lure of a wonderful wealthy lifestyle has brought those who have it, those that want it, and the criminals who will take it if they can.
title: The Strip

overview: New series following Newcastle's neighbourhood police teams and their partners as they tackle crime, disorder and the many unexpected challenges of keeping one of Britain's liveliest cities safe.
title: Geordie Coppers

overview: The story blends fiction and reality as a struggling, uninspired Paul lies to Amazon about the progress of his sold stand-up recording and life documentary, all while dealing with an ex and a chaotic best friend.
title: Paul, la série

overview: Glory Days follows a tight-knit group of four high school friends—Walker, Dave, Dominic, and Trigg—as they navigate their early careers and struggle to maintain their friendships into adulthood.
title: Glory Days

overview: Hosted by Indian cricket icon Rohit Sharma, two families go head-to-head in a high-stakes, laughter-filled gameshow featuring relatable trivia, nostalgic household challenges, and playful family rivalries.
title: Family Full House

overview: Stella returns to 1987 Patras to face her mother Xenia, a legendary nightclub singer who abandoned her at age five. Their reunion dredges up buried secrets, forcing both women to reckon with absence and the slow path toward forgiveness.
title: Ντέρτι

overview: The members of a Dutch football team have been playing together since they were little boys. Now, in their twenties, they all have have their own "grown-up" problems. With the team's 500th game coming up, personal issues take almost all their time...
title: All Stars

overview: When the editor of the "Dusty Bluffs Gazette" skips town, lifelong paperboys MP and Jer refuse to give up the only job they've ever wanted. With overconfidence and zero qualifications, the boys take the reins of a newspaper they've never read.
title: Dusty Bluffs

overview: A Japanese live-action tokusatsu television drama set in the Ryūga-verse continuity. Taking place after the events of "Heir to Steel Armor", the story centers on the collapse of the Eastern Region following a catastrophic desertification event caused by the Horror Garzas, and the defense of the region by the Golden Knight Ryuga Dougai.
title: Garo: Higashi no Kairo

overview: Chen Shou He, a craftsman who weaves with grass, incurs the wrath of Consort Chen over a piece of "Twinroot Grass" and is brutally tortured to death. His wife, Su Wan Niang, eagerly awaits his return, only to receive his corpse stuffed with withered grass. Devastated by grief, she assumes the identity of Su Cao, a female physician, and infiltrates the imperial city. Using a herbal medicine stall as her cover, she quietly builds an intelligence network and carefully plots her way closer to the emperor, one step at a time. She has only one goal: to avenge her murdered husband.
title: Revenge From A Wife

overview: She Lies in Wait seamlessly blends the past and present day, as we're introduced to seven teenagers, Topaz, Aurora, Callum, Benners, Jojo, Coralie and Brett, who go camping in Brinken Wood, part of the New Forest in July 2002. Only six teenagers emerge from the trip as 15-year-old Aurora mysteriously vanishes with no trace, instigating an exhaustive police investigation with public appeals by her family. Flipping deftly between the timelines, the surviving teenagers, including Aurora's sister Topaz, are now in their early 40s and successful in their careers. But what secrets do they harbour? They all claim to be innocent, but someone must surely be lying? Will the secrets of what happened that fateful night ever be known?
title: She Lies in Wait

overview: Each episode sees three junior geniuses (the Tiny Big Brains) paired with three different comics who try their best not to scupper the Tiny Big Brains' chances of victory!
title: Help Me Tiny Big Brain

overview: Discover how six survivalist dropped in the Filipino wilderness naked face harsh terrain, scarce resources, and constant exposure. Survival depends on endurance, resilience, adaptability, and smart decisions.
title: Naked and Afraid: Aadimanav

overview: A group of singles is once again going in search of love, and given the VIPS format, we will see some familiar faces returning.
title: Love Island VIPS

overview: In Location Unknown, we travel to the most inaccessible places in the world. Which team will be the first to reach the finish line within 48 hours?
title: Locatie Onbekend

overview: From creators John Sacret Young (China Beach), author Michael Connely ("The Black Echo" and "Angel's Flight") and newspaper reporter Josh Meyer comes an action thriller about a top secret federal group of technology and criminal experts that are the nations last and only defense against high-tech crooks.
title: Level 9

overview: In this program, an unexpected group of heroes embark on the adventure of a lifetime. Surviving on a deserted beach on the other side of the world. They all have some form of fame, but once on the beach that no longer matters and they have to rely on themselves. Completely outside their comfort zone, the personalities normally accustomed to luxury compete in duos.
title: Good Luck Guys: Overleven zonder filter

overview: This live television anthology series presents weekly, standalone adaptations of classic supernatural and gothic horror stories by authors like Edgar Allan Poe and W. W. Jacobs. Introduced by an off-screen narrator, each episode plunges everyday characters into unsettling encounters with the paranormal, featuring ominous doppelgängers, cursed artifacts, and psychological dread. Performed entirely in real-time, the show relies on atmospheric suspense and stagecraft to explore fate, guilt, and terror.
title: Great Ghost Tales

overview: Going beyond the four walls, Outside is the latest spin-off from the Sidemen's smash-hit seriesInside. A new group of content creators are thrown into the forest to battle for a prize of up to £1 million. With every comfort eating into the prize pot, they'll face brutal decisions, unpredictable challenges and plenty of Sidemen mischief as they fight to keep hold of the cash.
title: Outside

overview: A string of dogged journalists chases fugitive pop star Gary Glitter across the globe — from Cuba to Cambodia to Vietnam — determined to expose the child sexual abuse he concealed behind decades of chart-topping fame. This documentary follows their pursuit alongside the survivors who speak out, charting Glitter's 1997 conviction, through to his years on the run, and eventual incarceration.
title: Hunting Gary Glitter

overview: From the studio that brought you Lost, comes the groundbreaking series that captured the imaginations of fans from coast to coast. With an irresistible soundtrack and one of the most celebrated casts on television, including Harvey Keitel, Michael Imperioli, Gretchen Mol and Jason O Mara, Life on Mars is a smart, suspenseful drama with a finish that will blow you away. Its one of those endings I believe will make you watch the series again, says Executive Producer Josh Appelbaum. There s a fine line between delusion and reality. NYPD detective Sam Tyler finds himself walking both sides of that line when he is suddenly hurtled back in time to 1973 after being struck by a car in 2008. Journey back to the 70s and uncover the secrets of Life on Mars. It s a strange and exhilarating ride raves the New York Times. Plus, with unique and exciting bonus features including an insiders view of where the shows concept began, a six million dollar moment in which 1970s legend Lee Majors steps back into the past with the cast and crew, and much more.
title: Life on Mars

overview: The "American Idol" for aspiring country artists shifts from USA Network to NBC, as a group of hopefuls vies for a major recording contract with the Warner Bros. Nashville label, along with a bonus that's a very big deal: performing on the world's stage at the Summer Olympic Games in Beijing, China.
title: Nashville Star

overview: Catedrales is told across two timelines as the Sardá family confronts the devastating truth behind a thirty-year-old murder. In 1986, Ana, the youngest daughter of the devoutly religious family, is found dismembered and burned in a vacant lot. The case is closed without a suspect, and the family accepts their grief in silence — all except Lía, who walks away from everything. In 2018, Lía returns to Santiago to be with her dying father, whose last wish is to learn what happened to Ana. Moving between past and present, the series unravels a history steeped in religious extremism, forbidden love, and a web of lies that destroyed them all.
title: Catedrales

overview: Béatrice Clément, a 48-year-old qualified emergency physician, highly competent but also vulnerable and endearing, has for some time been experiencing inexplicable physical disorders. She passes all the tests, but her ailments persist. At the end of her resources, despite her resistance and skepticism, she resigns herself to seeing Monsieur P, a compassionate, compassionate, gentle psychologist who is gradually gaining his confidence. In the office where their interviews are held, the patients who pass through the doors of Beatrice's emergency every week echo her personal life and her past, reminding her that she knows how to manage her department masterfully. Her private life is something else ... In trying to be perfect and always in control, she faces comical and embarrassing situations, but also sometimes painful. His approach with Mr. P gradually affects all spheres of his life, be it the feelings that develop between her and the young resident, Olivier-Luc Laveaux, the strong ties of friendship she shares with her aunt Gin, the complicity she always feels with her ex-husband, Benoît and more particularly, the difficult relationship she has with her father, Christophe, a relationship that is based on a heavy secret of the past.
title: Au Secours De Beatrice

overview: A variety show around the K-Pop group ENHYPEN where they complete games, obstacle courses and much more.
title: EN-O'CLOCK

overview: The five main cast members—Park Bo Gum, Kim Yoo Jung, Jin Young, Chae Soo Bin, and Kwak Dong Yeon—reunite for a two-day, one-night trip to Hongcheon, where they spend time together, reminisce about the drama and their memories from 10 years ago, and show how their friendships have changed—or stayed the same—over the years.
title: Love in the Moonlight: Redrawn

overview: Η Έφη, μια μποέμ σχεδιάστρια μόδας, και ο Αλέξανδρος, ένας αυστηρός, συντηρητικός τεχνοκράτης, αναγκάζονται απροσδόκητα να συγκατοικήσουν, όταν κληρονομούν εξ αδιαιρέτου το ίδιο σπίτι. Δεσμευμένοι από αυστηρούς νομικούς όρους, οι δύο εντελώς διαφορετικοί χαρακτήρες συγκρούονται καθημερινά εξαιτίας του ασυμβίβαστου τρόπου ζωής τους. Η συνεχής μάχη τους για το ποιος θα επιβληθεί μετατρέπει τη συμβίωσή τους σε ένα διαρκές χάος, καθώς ο καθένας προσπαθεί με κάθε τρόπο να αναγκάσει τον άλλον να εγκαταλείψει το σπίτι.
title: Εξ Αδιαιρέτου

overview: New Granada, early 19th century. In this era, there are only two choices: one is either a Royalist or a Patriot. A fierce power struggle is underway, bringing with it injustice, countless tears, executions, war itself. Against this backdrop, extraordinary stories unfold, for people live each day literally as if it were their last. This is the setting for the story of La Pola, an untamed spirit, a visionary driven by ideals and a burning desire to fight for freedom, a woman ahead of her time in an era where rampant chauvinism denies women any voice or say. In an age when love is still eternal and a single kiss means everything, La Pola experiences a tumultuous, painful, and passionate romance with Alejo Sabaraín. He is a man forbidden to her in every respect: a nobleman of Spanish lineage, from a different social class and background, and, crucially, a supporter of the Crown. In short, their relationship is viewed as a sin. Yet, the attraction proves so powerful that the couple strives to embrace their love, regardless of the obstacles, even if it means facing death.
title: La Pola

overview: Driven by an agency manager who sends her to a new temporary assignment every week, an eccentric and highly literal-minded domestic worker blunders her way into bizarre high-stakes situations—ranging from murder mysteries to undercover police ops—accidentally solving the chaos through pure blind luck before moving on to her next job.
title: Grindl

overview: From online swindles to phone scams, Alexis Conran discovers how fraudsters manage to con people out of their hard-earned cash. With the help of fraud experts, he explains how to avoid falling victim to the scammers and their ever-evolving tactics.
title: Secrets of the Scammers

overview: Psychic medium Danielle Searancke uses a connection to Spirit to help people live big and meaningful lives. Disconnected from her Indigenous culture, Danielle is on a journey of reconnection: to self, family, culture, and the land itself.
title: Squamish Medium

overview: About a week before Christmas 2016, a truck plowed into the popular holiday market at Breitscheidplatz, a crowded public square. Twelve people died and many were injured in Germany's deadliest terror attack in decades.
title: Breitscheidplatz 19/12

overview: Using a 'Search for the Leading Actor' format, the show will cast the main and supporting CPs for our company's debut BL drama. It creates a complete business loop across talent-building, drama incubation, fan economy, and merchandise, serving as the launchpad for Chinese-language BL content on the global stage. Six men arrive at a seaside house as complete strangers, each searching for the partner who matches him best.
title: Project XY

overview: Eliza Stamatiou lives with her mother, Margarita, and her younger brother, Giorgos, somewhere in Brahami. Their financial situation is very good and everyone at home has relative freedom of movement. Eliza works for a large insurance company, but her "secret" desire is to work in cinema, regardless of her specialty. In the boredom of everyday life and a rather indifferent life, Eliza juxtaposes her imagination, which has been fueled by endless hours in movie theaters or in front of the video. Her generally unsuccessful attempts to transfer elements and situations from movies and their corresponding heroines to her daily life, provoke laughter and emotion.
title: Η Ελίζα και οι Άλλοι

overview: A heartwarming Greek sitcom centered on the daily lives, romantic misadventures, and enduring bond of a close-knit group of thirty-something friends and neighbors living in an apartment building in Athens.
title: Εμείς κι Εμείς

overview: Fan Chiang Jui Chen, heir to a powerful family, becomes ruthless amid deadly power struggles. His only weakness is his love for his seventh uncle, Fan Wei Hsia. Their bond ends in tragedy when Jui Chen dies saving Wei Hsi, who is later murdered seeking revenge. Fate sends Wei Hsi back to his youth with memories of their past life. Determined to change their destiny, he protects Jui Chen, only to findhim colder than before. When an accident restores Jui Chen's memories, they must confront old wounds and decide whether love can overcome fate.
title: Double Shuffle

overview: The series revolves around the fast-paced, dramatic, and humorous everyday life of the staff working at a fictional restaurant named Kotliarevskyi.
title: Котляревський

overview: Building Buffalo tells the story of the laborers, tradespeople, architects and contractors who built the Bills' state-of-the-art stadium, featuring Bills legends Thurman Thomas, Andre Reed and Steve Tasker alongside current players Damar Hamlin, Dawson Knox, DJ Moore and others.
title: Building Buffalo

overview: This isn't just a show about golf — it's a celebration of life going gloriously off course. In this series, Bill Murray and good friend and author, Tom Coyne play their way across some of the island's most legendary golf courses. But somewhere between the first tee and the final pint, the journey veers off course to meet the people who give it its soul, and why Bill loves his Irish heritage so much. Each episode follows Murray and friends across some of the island's most breathtaking fairways, with every episode featuring a different golf course and guest. The series offers an intimate portrait of an island whose stories, people and craic prove just as unforgettable as Bill Murray himself. Golf is just the excuse.
title: A Course Called Ireland

overview: Set against some of Britain's most beautiful landscapes, The Virgin Queen explores the full sweep of Elizabeth I's long and eventful life, from the young princess to the successful Queen, who turns England into a major world power. The drama explores her days of fear as a potential victim of her sister's terror and her great love affair with Robert Dudley. Some of the important political and historical events during her reign are highlighted as she balances personal life with the pressures of being a monarch. Her years of triumph over the Armada, her old age and her last enigmatic relationship with the young Earl of Essex are also captured.
title: The Virgin Queen

overview: Shen Zhiyi, a bride-to-be, finds out she is unexpectedly pregnant due to a bizarre medical mix-up. When she subsequently discovers her fiancé's infidelity, she calls off the wedding immediately and decides to raise the child alone as a single mother. Two years later, Gu Chenzhou—the cold, powerful president of the prominent Gu Group—presents her with a DNA test proving he is the biological father of her child. To give their son a complete family, Gu Chenzhou proposes a "trial marriage" contract with strict terms, promising a temporary arrangement with no romantic obligations. Despite his initially aloof demeanor, Gu Chenzhou becomes fiercely protective and devoted to both Shen Zhiyi and their child. What began as a businesslike arrangement transforms into real affection as Shen Zhiyi realizes Mr. Gu fell in love with her long before the "trial" ever began.
title: Mr. Gu, Happy Trial Marriage

overview: Psychological Improvisation is a show in which viewers ask personal questions to psychologist Maya Zozzatti right from the audience and receive a quick and clear analysis of their situations. Love, money, family, complexes and fears – in each episode, we explore what worries us, hinders our understanding of ourselves, and prevents us from building relationships with others.
title: Психологическая импровизация

overview: In this surprisingly emotional documentary, heavyweight champ Mike Tyson analyzes the controversies surrounding his career and turbulent private life.
title: Tyson

overview: Saman, la verità nascosta (Saman, The Hidden Truth) is a three-part docuseries that reconstructs the tragic story of Saman Abbas, the 18-year-old Pakistani girl killed in Novellara in 2021. Blending investigative journalism with cinematic storytelling, the series explores the clash between the young woman's desire for freedom and the rigid dictates of her family. It traces her rebellion, her tragic disappearance, and the complex investigation that culminated in the international judicial process.
title: Saman: La verità nascosta

overview: The Mafia Nanny centers on Davina who serves as an elite nanny to high-net-worth families. Her job should be straightforward: protect the charge, obey the client, and avoid becoming emotionally attached. But when Davina receives her first mission in the form of young Mikey Angelini, his imposing – and alluring – father threatens to drag her back into the world of organized crime she had tried to leave behind.
title: The Mafia Nanny

overview: Hard Feelings follows Claire Ambrose, New York City's most sought-after dating consultant, who teaches straight men communication skills and emotional intelligence while repeatedly choosing to date men who possess neither.
title: Hard Feelings

overview: Katie Greaves centers on the titular Katie Greaves, a whip-smart, fiercely committed attorney who stepped away from the New Hampshire Public Defender's office following a devastating personal tragedy. Now raising her two young granddaughters with her husband and trying to piece together a life she never expected, Katie is drawn back to the work that once defined her. Each case tests Katie's instincts, wit, and deeply held belief that everyone deserves a second chance... and someone to fight for them.
title: Katie Greaves

overview: Jude Derry arrives at this exclusive university with a hidden mission: to infiltrate the circle of the Cash brothers and uncover the truth about her brother's death. The three heirs to the family empire dominate Tagus with a magnetism that no one can resist. There's Aegan, the charismatic and calculating firstborn, Adrik, the enigmatic and mysterious middle brother, and Aleixandre, the rebellious and unpredictable youngest.
title: Perfectos mentirosos

overview: HaPijamot is an Israeli television sitcom about a struggling band determined to make it in the real world. The show follows the misadventures of three childhood friends: Ilan, Kobi and Oded, as they move from Netanya to Tel Aviv to launch their band. Unlike many shows, the characters in the show are aware that they are on television; the show features their day-to-day lives. A major aspect of the show is "HaMasach HaLavan" (the white screen), where cast members talk to the viewers. Gary, Kobi's uncle, who own the "hamburgary", also talks to the viewers when he is alone in his Black screen, often complaining about his wife or just his life in general. There are several interactive episodes, such as an episode which the viewers can fast forward or rewind to decide the outcome of the episode, an episode in which the viewers can record ringtones, and an episode with a cheaper form of scratch-and-sniff. The show always ends with the "Shtifat Kelim" - the characters washing the dishes for Gary and summarize the episode
title: HaPijamot

overview: The Serial Killer Connection reveals an unlikely bond forged in the aftermath of a serial killer's crimes. Decades after marrying Richard "Marc" Evonitz at a young age, Bonnie Lou learns that her former husband had been living a horrifying double life as a serial killer – with his deadly secret ultimately revealed after Kara Robinson Chamberlain's courageous escape from captivity. Years later, an unexpected connection sparked by a social media trend brings the two women together, transforming shared trauma into a determined quest for answers. United by a singular mission, the ex-wife and survivor of a serial killer unite in their determination to uncover the untold life and crimes of Evontiz and as they dig deeper, they confront the chilling possibility that the full scope of his crimes has yet to be revealed.
title: The Serial Killer Connection

overview: Don Leandro, a ruined marquis who lives on appearances and dreams of being named a Grandee of Spain, sees only one way out of his financial disaster: selling his decaying family mansion in Madrid. The perfect opportunity seems to arise when the immensely wealthy businesswoman Sofía Carrington takes an interest in the property. But as the negotiations (and seductions) progress, it becomes clear that they are not who they appear to be.
title: Grande de España

overview: A practical dating app founder and her adventurous competitor test their opposing theories about love through a 60-day challenge to find the right match.
title: #Love

overview: Duplicate of https://www.tvmaze.com/shows/93001/the-best-of-us The Best of Us dramatizes a landmark case that reshaped the fight for accountability: a relentless legal war that stretched nearly a decade to secure almost $1 billion in compensation for first responders who fell gravely ill in the wake of 9/11.
title: The Best of Us

overview: Set in Lisbon in 1941, during the height of World War II, neutral Portugal has become a hotbed of international espionage. Cândido de Oliveira—a former national football team player, co-founder of the Portuguese sports newspaper A Bola, and former manager of the Portuguese national team—uses his public fame, sporting travels, and media access as a cover to set up an anti-fascist intelligence network code-named Britânicos. Operating on behalf of the British Secret Intelligence Service (MI6) under the nose of Salazar's Estado Novo secret police (PVE), he works to smuggle intelligence and assist refugees, leading to his eventual arrest, torture, and imprisonment at the Tarrafal concentration camp in Cape Verde.
title: O Espião Que Veio do Futebol

overview: Miami is turning paradise into power — Wall Street South — a subtropical collision of industry titans, elite hedge funds, staggering wealth, ruthless competition, sex, nightlife and fun on an industrial scale. Into this sun-soaked arena comes a visionary billionaire who collects the brilliant, the hungry and the dangerous, then turns their ambitions loose on the markets that power America. He chases something bigger: the power to shift the center of economic gravity to Miami — and decide how long the party lasts.
title: The Spread

overview: The show follows groups of young adults traveling across the country in a signature green RV. Along the way, the "roadtrippers" interview leaders, creators, and professionals across diverse industries to uncover how they turned their personal passions into fulfilling careers.
title: Roadtrip Nation

overview: Evi and Vanessa, two 14-year-olds living in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, are best friends despite their opposing political beliefs. As nationwide disputes explode into vitriol and division in their hometown, the girls and others in the community work to navigate their differences and find a new path forward for their community.
title: Bucks County, USA

overview: A variety of programs aimed towards representing all aspects of Jamaican life.
title: JAM TV

overview: In Ladies of the House, when the charismatic owner of a winery dies unexpectedly, his wife and two adult daughters must battle through their issues with each other in order to confront challenges with the business, their extended family, and the men in their lives. Good friends and good wine will aid in the journey to hang on to the winery, but what matters most is that they find a way to hang on to each other.
title: Ladies of the House

overview: All the Rage is a half-hour dark revenge comedy about Emma and Eli, old friends who reconnect after a long estrangement and find new purpose in taking down the man who tore them apart.
title: All the Rage

overview: A devout young woman enters a cloistered convent, never imagining that her spirit will be crushed by the Mother Superior's abuses.
title: Cautiva

overview: Comedian Else Kåss Furuseth sets out alongside four ordinary individuals to unravel the mysteries of loneliness and social isolation, embarking on a candid journey to break taboos, share personal stories, and foster a genuine sense of belonging.
title: Kåss går det?

overview: Documentary series that reunites six soldiers who took part in major war events to discuss the impact it has had on their lives.
title: We Were There

overview: Michael Palin's latest adventure is an epic 2,500-mile journey across the islands of the Philippines. Known as an idyllic tropical travel hotspot, Michael also delves deeper to reveal a surprising, darker side. The legacy of Ferdinand and Imelda Marcos' spending, not just the shoes of legend but billions spent on monumental architecture, still haunts the country forty years on. Their son, Bongbong Marcos, is now President, and forty percent of the urban population lives in poverty, thirty thousand people have been lawlessly killed by vigilante anti-drug 'death squads', and a third of the country is on the UK Foreign Office 'do not travel list'. But despite all of this, Michael also experiences the Philippines as, ironically, one of the happiest and certainly the most beautiful countries he has ever visited.
title: Michael Palin in the Philippines

overview: A dedicated U.S. Navy doctor stationed at a San Diego naval base balances the daily medical and personal misadventures of military life alongside a charming base nurse and his eccentric commanding officer.
title: Hennesey

overview: Four British comedians deliver surreal, fast-paced sketch comedy built around absurd scenarios, everyday awkwardness, and physical humor.
title: The Hollow Men

overview: Hullabaloo is an American musical variety series that ran on NBC from January 12, 1965 through August 29, 1966. Similar to Shindig! it ran in prime time in contrast to ABC's American Bandstand.
title: Hullabaloo

overview: A story that follows Ji Yichuan, a gifted young warrior of the Ji clan who encounters all kinds of hardships yet ultimately relies on his own strength to defend his home. While under orders to guard a monster, Ji Yichuan chances upon a sacred beast. Along the way, he meets Yu Chixue. Ji Yichuan must face punishment for his infraction as the monster escaped. Yu Chixue gets seriously injured in her attempt to help him capture the monster. He secures the help of Lan Lingyu, a disciple of the Medicine King. Ji Yichuan embarks on a journey with Yu Chixue and Lan Lingyu in search for the immortal land. They cross paths with Shao Yan Wang who has assumed the pseudonym Wang Yan. Shao Yan Wang feigns kindness while pulling the strings from the background. Through many trials and tribulations, they discover the mastermind.
title: The Origin of Love

overview: A biologist's struggle to rewild a river divides the town of Elverkilde, shatters her family, and uncovers dark secrets from the past.
title: Rivalerne

overview: A monthly long-form interview series hosted by Rachel Maddow exploring politics, history, and public life.
title: Rachel Maddow: In Conversation With…

overview: A weekly behind-the-scenes program hosted by Lawrence O'Donnell looking at stories that did not fit into his regular television broadcast.
title: The Very Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell

overview: Because We Care with Richard Lui is an exclusive talk series on the MS NOW platform where anchor and caregiving advocate Richard Lui brings caregivers front and center by sitting down with public figures, founders, and innovators to share personal stories of compassion, practical solutions, and resources.
title: Because We Care with Richard Lui

overview: Off the Charts with Ali Velshi features Ali Velshi at the MS NOW "Big Board" to provide a deeper dive into the latest polling, voter data, and political numbers. [1]
title: Off the Charts with Ali Velshi

overview: Andrew Weissmann, MS NOW Legal Analyst and former FBI General Counsel, is answering YOUR legal news questions. Join the discussion on the Community page and submit your legal news questions for Andrew to answer in a future episode.
title: Answers with Andrew Weissmann

overview: Hosted by Claire McCaskill, featuring conversations with lawmakers and everyday people across the Midwest.
title: Political Potluck with Claire McCaskill

overview: Jep! a children's version of Jeopardy!
title: Jep!

overview: Shu Tinglan, scarred by family trauma from her upbringing, grew into a sensitive, love-starved young woman. As an adult, she crosses paths with Zhuo Yu'an, the CEO of a tech company, through work. What neither realizes at first is that they were already close back in high school, only to be torn apart by a misunderstanding at graduation. When they reunite, they find themselves in an unexpected client-and-vendor relationship. Through every trial and emotional twist along the way, the two finally find their happily-ever-after.
title: Unsoiled Starlight

overview: Lucía Trevi has two dreams in life: to become a famous Hollywood actress and to win the love of José Simón Landaeta. She knows the first is practically impossible... but the second, why not? Like Cinderella, this cheerful, sweet, yet poor young woman believes that dreams can come true if one desires them intensely enough. Perhaps as a reward for such optimism, life grants Lucía the opportunity she craves: to connect with the distinguished Landaeta family and thereby get closer to her idol. One afternoon, while making a delivery for the deli where she works, Lucía falls victim to a pickpocket... and the man who comes to her rescue, purely by chance, is Roberto Landaeta, José Simón's brother. Handsome and charming, yet down-to-earth and kind, Roberto is captivated by Lucía's beauty and warmth, and begins to woo her. Upon learning that she comes from humble means and must work to support her father, Roberto decides that to win Lucía's love on his own merits, free from the influence of his surname and fortune, he should hide his true identity. He tells her he is a labourer at the Landaeta corporation, rather than revealing that he is one of its owners. A beautiful friendship blossoms between Roberto and Lucía, even though she cannot stop thinking about her "Prince Charming," José Simón. She sees him in society magazines, unaware that he is closer than she imagines. Unlike Roberto, José Simón is arrogant, domineering, and dismissive of anyone he considers socially inferior. He would never take notice of a girl like Lucía, despite the countless schemes she devises to meet him. She only manages to catch his attention through a misunderstanding, when he happens to mistake her for the aristocratic Countess of Fernese.
title: Girasoles para Lucía

overview: A thousand years ago, Jiang Shiwei, the eldest daughter of a noble family, fell in love with Se Chen, the son of a military officer; but, bound by the fates of their families, they took their own lives together. Carrying with her memories of her past life and an unwavering desire to love with all her heart, Shiwei searched for Se Chen from one life to the next and finally met him again. She proposed to him, but he flatly refused. Disappointed, she unexpectedly ran into Se Chen once more, and he gradually...
title: Year After Year

overview: On each episode of Scribes & Scriveners, we sit down with a Black Library author to discuss their books. They take us inside their writing process and reveal the secrets of creating fan favourite stories and characters.
